entries.text: The 17 TPC-DS OBT DataFrame queries use their `obt_*` names as query IDs (`obt_row_count`, `obt_channel_revenue` and so on) instead of `Q1` to `Q17`, which read as TPC-DS query numbers although the DataFrame queries are OBT-native and match no TPC-DS query. `--queries` selects them by the new names, and DataFrame OBT results are labelled with them.
